BEFORE YOU CHOOSE

A little clarity.

We’re here to help you find your favorites.

How much do the products cost?

Each product shows its price in Colombian pesos (COP) and its size, when available. Your bag shows the total for your chosen quantities. Ask us about delivery costs before confirming an order.

How can I ask about an order?

Choose your favorites, open your bag and select “Ask about my bag”. WhatsApp opens with a draft you can review and send. We’ll confirm availability, delivery and payment details directly. The website does not take payment.

Where do I find ingredients and directions?

Open the product details and refer to its packaging. If you need help with ingredients, sizes or usage directions, message us before choosing.

Can I ask about delivery in Bogotá?

Yes. Send us your delivery area on WhatsApp so we can confirm coverage, cost and estimated delivery time before you order.
